text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp of our third year 
came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Summer camp!! IT'S THE FREAKIN' BEEEEST!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, see ya! Let's train like crazy back 
at the academy too, Trainer!!

Along with Biwa Hayahide and Narita 
Taishin, Winning Ticket boisterously 
boards the bus.

Our next goal is the Arima Kinen. I 
psyched myself up all over again to ensure 
we could run the "best race ever."
